sentences.en: Many people underestimate the importance of water to the body.
sentences.zh: 很多人低估了水对人体的重要性。

sentences.en: The French underestimated the force of Algeria's National Liberation Front.
sentences.zh: 法国人低估了阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线的力量。

sentences.en: She beat me. I had underestimated the power of a woman.
sentences.zh: 她赢了我。我低估了一个女人的力量。

senses.zh: 低估，对……估计不足；轻视，小看（某人）

mnemonic: 合成词：under（不足）+estimate（估计） →估计不足→低估
